scientific_scope.target: ranking proximity to QFFD traces coded as Inferred under a proxy label
scientific_scope.temporal_attention_role: evaluated method, not presumed contribution or superior model
scientific_scope.primary_question: Does explicit temporal attention provide a stable advantage over capacity-matched convolution and seasonal concatenation across four spatial folds?
prohibited_claims: calibrated probability of geological fault presence
robustness inferred from a single fold or selected seed

data.test_access: one evaluation after checkpoint selection for each completed run

deep_models.input: four seasons and all eight variables
four seasons and all eight variables
four seasons and seven non-ST variables

random_forest_models.features: 32 direct channels plus 7x7 mean and std for ST, NIR, and NDVI in four seasons; 56 total

sampler.reason: avoid combining 50:50 center oversampling with a second full class-weight correction

loss.name: BCEWithLogitsLoss
loss.positive_weight_policy: eligible training negative pixels divided by positive pixels, independently per fold

random_forest_training.training_pixels: all eligible train.npy pixels; no class downsampling
random_forest_training.validation_use: diagnostic metrics only; no hyperparameter selection

evaluation.validation_selected_threshold: may be reported separately as descriptive and never replaces fixed-threshold test metrics
evaluation.seed_ensemble: arithmetic mean of four seed probability maps within each model and fold
evaluation.primary_model_summary: equal-weight mean and standard deviation of four fold-level seed-ensemble AP values
evaluation.supplementary_summary: pooled out-of-fold predictions and all 16 individual fold-seed results
evaluation.uncertainty: report fold and seed dispersion; no pixelwise bootstrap confidence interval
evaluation.model_ranking_boundary: only primary_capacity_matched models support direct architecture attribution

run_matrix.required_completion: all configured model x fold x seed cells before aggregate comparison

failure_policy.transient_system_failure: retry the identical model, fold, seed, config, and code hash; retain every attempt record
failure_policy.nan_or_nonfinite_loss: mark failed and stop the affected protocol batch for review; do not change one run silently
failure_policy.out_of_memory: stop and revise the common protocol for every affected deep model; do not use a one-off batch size
failure_policy.early_stopping: a valid completed run, not a failure
failure_policy.incomplete_matrix: report incomplete; do not compute a final model ranking

output_schema.hashes: SHA-256 for config, code, masks, normalization, checkpoint/model, probability arrays, and result files

change_control.protocol_change_after_any_test_evaluatio: create a new protocol version and rerun every affected comparison cell
